readiness_evidence: Not ready to offer: this release has not been replayed in a hosted session. A Base44 Superagent replay of 0.10.1 on 22/10/26 stopped at this defect: after a sandbox wipe that kept the saved folder, the new conversation found no linked state, ran `flow init --no-persistent-root`, and started a new booking that asked for a second Link sign-in, although the saved booking (waiting for the user's yes) and the sign-in were intact. Nothing was booked or charged.

Offline: `flow status`, `flow init` (with or without `--no-persistent-root`), and `runtime doctor` now find an unfinished booking in a persistent folder this CLI prepared earlier and point at `runtime prepare --persistent-root <folder>`; linking that folder brings the waiting booking back at the summary step; a folder this CLI never prepared is not treated as saved state. The tests fail without the change; the full suite passes.

Existing businesses and the registry stay compatible: no USP, UCP, or platform profile version changed and no request shape changed. Saved session files are unchanged: no field was added and the format version stays as it is.
user_summary: After a restart, the assistant finds your saved booking and Link sign-in again instead of starting a new booking.
